text:
maya: Noticing a steady rise in fncall schema rejects in us-central since 11:12 UTC. Reject reason: TOOL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH / INVALID_RESPONSE_SHAPE. Any recent rollouts that could explain?
jon: Saw the alert here too. Our dashboard spike aligns with the strict-validator canary rollout at 11:00.
li: Canary at 10% in us-central per deploybot. I saw some adapters return an empty array for `meta` when they should return an object.
eli: Confirmed. One adapter path in v2.9 returns [] when no meta. Patch ready to return {} and adding a unit test. Will release in ~8m.
maya: Example rejected payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "customer_profile",
  "result": {
    "status": "ok",
    "meta": []
  },
  "request_id": "r_12345"
}
```
validator expects `meta` to be an object map.
jon: Temporary mitigation: should we enable soft-validate for the affected customer shards while the patch lands? ops?
ops: We can flip soft-validate for impacted accounts. Doing that now for tenant shard `t-05`. Will annotate the incident.
maya: UX request for Console: add a `reject_reason` column in the fncall rejects list and a permissioned `raw_sample` link that shows the unmasked payload for triage. Current masked samples slow debugging.
li: Also propose a rollout toggle in Console: `auto-fallback-on-validator-spike` where you can configure threshold (percent rejects) and cooldown. That would route traffic to the permissive variant automatically.
eli: Strong +1 for traceability: emit `validator.mode` and `validator.canary_pct` as trace/span tags so we can correlate rejects with rollout state. Right now traces are missing that signal.
jon: Operational caveat: auto-fallback reduces customer-facing 400s but increases cost/latency. We need an audit log and per-account opt-out flag.
maya: For telemetry, add two metrics: `fncall.validator.hard_rejects` and `fncall.validator.soft_validations`. Plot by region and by rollout slice.
ops: Add RBAC for raw sample access and retention policy: keep 1% of raw samples for 7 days in secure bucket with PII review gating.
li: Patch released and rolling out to adapters. Will post release notes and ping when I revert soft-validate.
maya: Thanks. After patch lands let's run a quick canary health check: 5m window, look for rejects <0.5%. If good, rollback soft-validate for t-05.
console-bot: deploybot: strict-validator canary enabled at 11:00 UTC (10% us-central) by li
console-bot: opsbot: incident created (#3021) "fncall-validator rejects spike - us-central" assigned to eng-platform
